title: Typescript Tutorial
description: Learn TypeScript step-by-step, from installation to advanced features like types, interfaces, and generics. Includes interactive code challenges and practical examples for each topic.

content.content: Install TypeScript
TypeScript can be installed via npm: https://www.typescriptlang.org/#installation

content: Run `npm install -g typescript` to install TypeScript globally

content.content: Hello World Program
TypeScript files use the .ts extension and can be compiled to JavaScript.

let message: string = 'Hello, TypeScript!';
console.log(message);

questions.question: Write a TypeScript program that prints 'Hello, TypeScript!'

content.content: Declaring Variables
Variables can be declared using `let`, `const`, or `var` with explicit types.

questions.question: Create a variable 'age' of type number with value 30 and print it

content.content: Basic Data Types
TypeScript supports types like string, number, boolean, array, tuple, enum, any, and void.

questions.question: Create a boolean variable 'flag' as true and print it

content.content: Function Types
Functions can have typed parameters and return types.

questions.question: Write a function 'multiply' that multiplies two numbers and prints the result

content.content: Using Interfaces
Interfaces define object shapes and can be used for type checking.

questions.question: Create an interface 'Car' with properties 'make' and 'year' and print make

content.content: Classes and Objects
TypeScript supports ES6 classes with typed properties and methods.

questions.question: Create a class 'Person' with a name property and method to print it

content.content: Generic Functions
Generics allow writing reusable functions and classes with types.

questions.question: Write a generic function that returns the value passed and print it

content.content: Import and Export
TypeScript supports ES6 modules using `export` and `import`.

questions.question: Export a function 'greet' from a module and import it to print 'Hello'
